messages:
anya: Quick kickoff for Ember-21B quant + hybrid canary plan.
- Goal: onboard Ember-21B into hosted + dedicated with int8/int4 candidates, validate quality vs prod baseline, and stage traffic with safe fallbacks.
anya: Success gates: quality delta <=2% on core evals, p95 latency within SLO, hosted cost per token <1.8x baseline.
ravi: I’ll own quant builds. Plan: int8 (primary) + int4 (experimental) using Kernel v3 with per-layer fallback where needed. Starting runs now.
qa-sam: We’ll run the standard eval suite (conv/summ/code/retrieval) + 250 adversarial prompts. Human sampling for hallucinations.
mel: QA gating: rouge/EM/embedding-sim drop >2% => abort. Hallucination >1.5% (sampled) => rollback.
ravi: Perf targets: p95 <=900ms on a100-80GB for 512 tokens, throughput >=110 tok/s per GPU on p4d with batch=16.
ops-alex: Dedicated + Private ops checklist: reserve 2 GPUs in ded pool, build image (sha256), verify KMS keys, update firewall/egress. I need the image tag when ready.
anya: Canary stages (example): 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 30m/1h/2h/1h windows. Auto-rollback on alerts.
anya: Rollback rules: error_rate>0.5% OR p95>1200ms OR quality_regression>2% OR OOM.
anya: Config snippet:
```json
{"stages":[{"pct":1,"dur":"30m"},{"pct":5,"dur":"1h"},{"pct":20,"dur":"2h"},{"pct":100,"dur":"1h"}],"rollback_on":["error_rate>0.5%","p95>1200ms","quality_regression>2%"]}
```
ravi: KV-cache warmup script matters for convo workloads. Example warmup:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 150); do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"ember-21b","input":"Hello there"}' https://hosted.api.redwood/v1/generate > /dev/null
done
```
ci-bot: perf-job/ember-quant-202634 started by ravi. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/ember-quant-202634
mel: QA: enable token-level tracing for canary traffic for 48h. Freeze API/schema changes during windows.
qa-sam: Regression thresholds to commit: embedding cosine drop >0.025 triggers alert; rouge/LM >2% abort; sampled hallucination >1.5% abort.
ops-alex: For private deploys add traffic-mirroring from Dedicated and perform image attestation before shifting prod.
anya: Observability dashboard to watch: p50/p95 latency, error rate, cost/1k tokens, top-5 failure signatures (bad stops, truncation, malformed JSON). Notify #eng-oncall on rollback.
ravi: I’ll attach quant diff tables + perf CSVs to the rollout ticket when CI finishes.
mel: Smoke QA ETA after builds: 10-16h depending on queue. We’ll start spot-checks once artifacts available.
anya: I’ll open the rollout ticket and assign owners. React with :raised_hands: if you pick an item or +1 to acknowledge.
qa-sam: I’ll prepare the Kaleidoscope diff report and 30 sample prompts for product review.
ops-alex: Added: SLA note for Dedicated -- ensure reserved capacity 2x buffer for burst. Will coordinate with infra on budget.
ravi: Will run per-layer sensitivity and fallback mapping before canary. If int4 regresses on critical buckets, fallback to int8 automatically.
anya: Great. Let’s sync again after CI finishes and perf artifacts land. Thanks everyone :rocket:
